methodologyNotes: Prices fetched June 2026 from each vendor's official pricing page. Where the official page returned only JS-rendered content (Lucidchart's lucid.app redirect, Figma annual toggle), the primary data came from that official URL but confirmed via a reputable third-party review source (GetApp, SoftwareAdvice) noted as corroboration. draw.io is free/open-source (Apache 2.0) with no paid tiers. Whimsical advertises '17% off' for annual billing but does not display the exact annual price on the page; the per-month annual rates are computed as round-number estimates and flagged in notes. Figma's Organization and Enterprise plans are annual-only; no monthly-billed equivalent is offered. All telephony fields (minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, overagePerCall) are null throughout as this is a non-telephony vertical.

vendors.provenance: Official pricing page miro.com/pricing/ fetched directly.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Unlimited members; 3 editable boards; 5,000+ templates; 10 Miro AI credits/month per team.

plans.name: Business

plans.name: Enterprise

plans.name: Free

plans.name: Enterprise

vendors.name: draw.io
vendors.provenance: Official site drawio.com fetched directly. Product is entirely free and open source (Apache 2.0). Vendor explicitly states 'No artificial scarcity, no Enterprise tier for SSO.' No paid plans exist.

plans.name: Free
